title: 1947 National Security Act and Majestic 12

tellings.quote: It it is. And then you get into the 1947 National Security Act with creating the Air Force, the CIA, the National Security Council, which you and I discussed, which is how much was Majestic 12 tied into National Security Council.

plain: The National Security Act of 1947 created the US Air Force, the CIA and the National Security Council, the President's top security body. The researcher Dylan Borland goes over this on Michels's show without naming a source and asks how closely Majestic 12, a secret group said to handle UFO matters, was tied into that council. If true, the UFO secret would sit inside the structures set up that very year.
